commitResults.messageTitle: Rename chatbot from Duke to Clearblue
commitResults.messageBody: Rename the Java entry point, update the ASCII banner, and refresh documentation references.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add command echoing and bye handling
commitResults.messageBody: Read user input in a loop, echo regular commands with formatted dividers, and exit with a farewell message when the user enters `bye`.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add task storage and list command
commitResults.messageBody: Store up to 100 user-entered tasks and display them in numbered order when the user enters `list`.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add task completion tracking with a Task class
commitResults.messageBody:
Represent each task as a Task object that owns its description and completion
state. Support marking and unmarking tasks, and display their status consistently
in task lists and command confirmations.

commitResults.messageTitle: feat: add typed tasks and console UI regression tests
commitResults.messageBody:
Add todo, deadline, and event task types with command parsing,
validation, and type-specific display formatting.

Add a project-specific UI testing skill and exact-output test plan
to verify console behavior after future source-code changes.

commitResults.messageTitle: feat: handle invalid chatbot commands safely
commitResults.messageBody:
Validate missing task details, unknown commands, and invalid task
numbers before processing them to prevent runtime errors.

Expand the UI test plan with malformed-input scenarios to verify
that errors are explained clearly without ending the session.

commitResults.messageTitle: feat: add task deletion support
commitResults.messageBody:
Add a validated delete command that removes the selected task and
renumbers the remaining list without leaving stale array entries.

Extend UI tests to cover successful deletion, list compaction, and
invalid delete commands.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: use enum for chatbot command types
commitResults.messageBody:
Introduce CommandType to represent the fixed set of supported commands
and replace repeated string-based dispatch with an enum switch.

Extend UI coverage to ensure argument-free commands still reject
unexpected extra input after the parsing refactor.

commitResults.messageTitle: feat: save tasks to disk on every change
commitResults.messageBody:
Add a Storage class that writes the task list to data/clearblue.txt
(a relative, OS-independent path) whenever a task is added, marked,
unmarked, or deleted. Reading the saved file back on startup is not
implemented yet.

Add getters (getDescription/isDone on Task, getBy on Deadline,
getFrom/getTo on Event) so Storage can encode a task without reaching
into protected fields from outside the Task hierarchy.

commitResults.messageTitle: feat: load saved tasks on startup, handle missing/corrupted data
commitResults.messageBody:
Add Storage.load(), called at chatbot startup, which reads
data/clearblue.txt and rebuilds the task list.

Handle the cases required by the assignment:
- Missing data file/folder (e.g. first run on a new machine) is treated
  as an empty list rather than an error.
- A corrupted or malformed line (stretch goal) is skipped instead of
  crashing the chatbot; other valid lines still load.

commitResults.messageTitle: test: keep UI regression cases isolated from saved task data
commitResults.messageBody:
Clearblue now persists tasks to data/clearblue.txt, which would leak
state between UI test cases since they all run in the same working
directory. Have run_ui_tests.py delete the data folder before each
case (and after the full run) so the plan's "fresh process, empty
task list" guarantee still holds.

Document the persistence behavior and its manual verification in
ui-test-plan.md, and ignore the data folder in .gitignore.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge branch 'branch-Level-7'
Adopt SE-EDU Git and Java conventions
commitResults.messageBody:
AGENTS.md now references the SE-EDU Git and Java (Intermediate)
convention guides so future sessions follow them without needing a
live fetch.

Let's bring the codebase into compliance with the Java conventions:
every class now lives in a package (clearblue) instead of the
default package, moving all source files under
src/main/java/clearblue/ and updating the compile/run commands in
test/ui-test-plan.md and the file path in README.md to match. Add
the Javadoc that was missing on Task's constructor and mutator
methods, Clearblue.main(), and the getters added for Storage.

commitResults.messageTitle: Parse yyyy-MM-dd deadlines and events as dates
commitResults.messageBody:
Level 8 asks the chatbot to understand dates/times instead of
treating them as plain strings, formatting yyyy-MM-dd input as
MMM dd yyyy for display.

Let's add TaskDateTime, a small wrapper that tries to parse the
/by, /from, and /to text as a LocalDate and falls back to the
original text unchanged when it doesn't match. The fallback keeps
existing free-text deadlines/events (e.g. "Sunday", "no idea :-p")
working exactly as before, so no existing behavior regresses.

Deadline and Event now store a TaskDateTime instead of a String.
Storage.encode() saves the value's original raw text rather than
its formatted display text, so a real date re-parses into a
LocalDate again on the next load instead of degrading into free
text.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add UI regression cases for date parsing
Add on command to list tasks by date (stretch goal)
commitResults.messageBody:
Matches a deadline on its by date, or an event on its from or to
date; todos never match. Unknown-command message now mentions on too.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add UI regression cases for the on command
commitResults.messageBody:
TC-11 covers matching deadlines/events; TC-12 covers no matches,
an invalid date, and a missing argument. Updated the unknown-command
message text everywhere it appears.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge branch 'branch-Level-8'
Extract Ui and TaskList classes
commitResults.messageBody:
Ui owns all console I/O; TaskList owns the task collection (now an
ArrayList, dropping the old 100-task cap, which was only an
artifact of the fixed-array approach). Storage now works with
List<Task> to match. Clearblue.main() just orchestrates them.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract Parser class
commitResults.messageBody:
Moves command-type and argument parsing out of Clearblue.main() into
a dedicated Parser, matching CommandType/Storage/TaskList/Ui as
single-responsibility classes.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add ClearblueException; Storage throws instead of printing
commitResults.messageBody:
Storage previously printed its own OOPS!!! messages directly,
mixing storage and UI concerns. It now throws ClearblueException on
an I/O failure, and Clearblue catches it and reports through Ui,
same as every other error path. Missing-file/folder still isn't an
error, and corrupted lines are still skipped silently.

commitResults.messageTitle: Make Clearblue and Storage instance-based
commitResults.messageBody:
Clearblue now holds ui/storage/tasks as instance fields, with a
constructor that loads and a run() that drives the command loop,
instead of one big static main(). Storage takes its file path in
its constructor rather than a hardcoded static path, so it's no
longer tied to one fixed location.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract Command classes (stretch goal)
commitResults.messageBody:
AddCommand/ListCommand/MarkCommand/DeleteCommand/OnCommand/
ExitCommand replace the switch in run(). Parser.parse() now does
all syntax validation and returns a ready Command, throwing
ClearblueException on bad input instead of returning an error
string; run() becomes a single try/catch/finally loop.

Note: task-number/date range checks (e.g. "Task 2 does not exist")
still need the current task list, so they happen in each command's
execute() rather than in Parser, unlike the pure-syntax checks.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge branch 'branch-A-MoreOOP'
Split into subpackages by responsibility (stretch goal)
commitResults.messageBody:
clearblue.task, clearblue.command, clearblue.parser,
clearblue.storage, clearblue.ui. Clearblue and ClearblueException
stay at the root since ClearblueException is thrown across parser,
command, and storage. Updated the test runner's compile command for
the new subdirectories.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge branch 'branch-A-Gradle'
Add JUnit tests for TaskDateTime and Parser
commitResults.messageBody:
Covers TaskDateTime's date-vs-text parsing/formatting and Parser's
full command set (happy paths plus validation errors).

The tests caught a real bug: the default SMART date resolver
silently rolled an invalid date like 2019-04-31 forward to a
different date instead of rejecting it. Fixed by switching
TaskDateTime's parser to STRICT resolution with uuuu (proleptic
year) instead of yyyy, since STRICT + yyyy can't resolve a year
without an explicit era.

Rename shadowJar output to clearblue.jar
commitResults.messageBody:
Was still 'duke.jar' from the original template. Verified the fat

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge branch 'branch-A-Jar'
Add find command to search tasks by description
commitResults.messageBody:
Case-insensitive substring match against each task's description,
via TaskList.getTasksContaining(). Reports "no tasks match" when
nothing found, and requires a keyword.

Add TC-13/TC-14 UI regression cases, JUnit coverage in ParserTest,
and update the unknown-command message everywhere it appears.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add Javadoc to every non-private class/method (stretch goal)
commitResults.messageBody:
Fills in the remaining gaps: Command subclasses' execute()/isExit()
overrides, every toString() override, and non-trivial private
helpers (Parser's parseXxx methods, TaskList.isOnDate(),
TaskDateTime.parseOrNull()).
